metadata.description: Dual data center with active/standby load balancing and three-zone defense-in-depth architecture per DC: outer DMZ, Auth Zone (auth gateway + IAM + token cache), and App Zone (inner firewall + web app + LDAP + DB + internal logging server). A CDN edge fronts the global load balancer for user traffic. Each DC has its own Monitoring Zone with a local SIEM that ingests from its DC logging server; the two SIEMs cross-replicate to keep monitoring self-sufficient on failover. Users pass geofencing (zone + IP + telecom MFA) and IAM auth in the Auth Zone before the inner firewall admits them to the App Zone. Admin/audit users authenticate separately through the Auth Zone to access internal logging servers directly — no load balancer involved for log access. DB and app components write logs directly to the logging server. Log data replicates between DCs.

elements.name: User Clients
elements.description: End users accessing the web application via browser; receive SMS MFA codes on their mobile phones

elements.name: Global Load Balancer
elements.description: DNS-based / anycast global traffic manager. Routes requests to DC1 (active) and DC2 (failover)

elements.name: Geofencing Service
elements.description: External SaaS that enforces geographic access policies. Validates user zone via IP geolocation and cell-tower location data provided by the telecom provider, then coordinates the MFA challenge

elements.name: Telecom Provider
elements.description: Mobile network operator. Supplies cell-tower location data to the geofencing service and delivers SMS MFA codes to user mobile devices

elements.name: CDN Edge
elements.description: Content delivery network edge cache. Terminates user TLS, serves cached static assets, and forwards dynamic requests to the global load balancer

elements.name: Data Center 1 — Primary
elements.description: Primary data center. Handles live traffic across three network zones: DMZ, Auth Zone, and App Zone

elements.name: DMZ
elements.description: Outer perimeter zone in DC1. Terminates inbound TLS from the global load balancer and forwards to the Auth Zone; no direct path to the App Zone

elements.name: Outer Firewall DC1
elements.description: Outer stateful firewall. Permits only HTTPS inbound and blocks all direct traffic to the App Zone

elements.name: Load Balancer DC1
elements.description: Application load balancer in the DC1 DMZ. Routes HTTPS traffic to the Auth Zone gateway

elements.name: Auth Zone
elements.description: Authentication and policy-enforcement zone in DC1. All sessions must pass geofencing and IAM checks here before a token is issued and the inner firewall is opened

elements.name: Auth Gateway DC1
elements.description: Auth gateway acting as the policy enforcement point. Receives sessions from the LB, delegates auth to the IAM server and geofencing check, and forwards validated sessions through the inner firewall to the App Zone

elements.name: IAM Server
elements.technology: Identity and Access Management (IdP / Auth Server)
elements.description: Primary IAM server (e.g., Keycloak). Issues and validates JWT tokens, enforces RBAC policies, and calls the geofencing service for zone and MFA verification. Writes issued tokens to the token store

elements.name: Token Store
elements.description: In-memory token and session cache in the Auth Zone. Enables fast token validation by the auth gateway without hitting the IAM server on every request

elements.name: App Zone
elements.description: Inner application zone in DC1. Only reachable through the inner firewall after a valid token has been issued in the Auth Zone

elements.name: Inner Firewall DC1
elements.description: Inner stateful firewall. Permits only traffic carrying a valid session token from the Auth Zone; blocks all unauthenticated paths

elements.name: Web App 1
elements.description: Primary web application server. Processes authenticated requests from the inner firewall, queries LDAP for user attributes, and reads/writes the primary database

elements.name: LDAP Directory
elements.description: Authoritative user directory. Stores identities, group memberships, and access policies. Queried by the web app for authorisation decisions after the auth check

elements.name: PostgreSQL Primary
elements.description: Primary PostgreSQL database. Handles all read and write operations; streams WAL replication to DC2; ships structured access and edit audit events to the logging service

elements.name: Data Center 2 — Standby
elements.description: Standby data center. Receives continuous replication from DC1 across all three zones; promoted to active on DC1 failure

elements.name: DMZ
elements.description: Outer perimeter zone in DC2. Ready to accept failover traffic

elements.name: Outer Firewall DC2
elements.description: Outer stateful firewall in DC2 DMZ

elements.name: Load Balancer DC2
elements.description: Application load balancer in DC2 DMZ. Activated on failover

elements.name: Auth Zone
elements.description: Authentication and policy-enforcement zone in DC2. Mirrors DC1 Auth Zone; uses replicated IAM and token store for standalone operation on failover

elements.name: Auth Gateway DC2
elements.description: Auth gateway in DC2 Auth Zone. Delegates authentication to the replicated IAM stack and forwards validated sessions through the inner firewall to the App Zone during failover

elements.name: IAM Replica
elements.description: Replicated IAM server in DC2 Auth Zone. Stays in sync with the DC1 primary; provides full auth capability locally on failover

elements.name: Token Store Replica
elements.description: Replica of the DC1 token cache. Ensures active sessions remain valid when traffic fails over to DC2

elements.name: App Zone
elements.description: Inner application zone in DC2. Only reachable after successful auth in the DC2 Auth Zone

elements.name: Inner Firewall DC2
elements.description: Inner stateful firewall in DC2 App Zone

elements.name: Web App 2
elements.description: Standby web application server. Serves traffic when DC2 is promoted to active

elements.name: LDAP Replica
elements.description: Read replica of the LDAP directory. Keeps DC2 self-sufficient for authorisation lookups on failover

elements.name: PostgreSQL Replica
elements.description: Standby PostgreSQL replica. Receives streaming replication from DC1 primary; promoted to read-write on failover; ships read-access audit events to the logging service

elements.name: Admin / Audit Users
elements.description: Administrators and auditors. Access the internal logging servers via a dedicated admin login through the Auth Zone — not through the user load balancer

elements.name: Logging Server DC1
elements.description: Internal centralised logging server in DC1 App Zone. Receives DB access and edit events from db_primary and app event logs from web_app_1. Accessible only to authenticated admin users via the Auth Zone inner firewall. Replicates log data to DC2.

elements.name: Logging Server DC2
elements.description: Internal centralised logging server in DC2 App Zone. Receives DB read events from db_replica and app event logs from web_app_2. Accessible to admins on failover. Receives replicated log data from DC1.

elements.name: Monitoring Zone DC1
elements.description: DC1 monitoring zone. Hosts the local SIEM that ingests logs from logging_server_1 and replicates state to DC2

elements.name: SIEM DC1
elements.description: Local SIEM in DC1. Pulls logs from logging_server_1, performs correlation and threat detection, and replicates state to the DC2 SIEM for failover continuity

elements.name: Monitoring Zone DC2
elements.description: DC2 monitoring zone. Hosts the local SIEM that ingests logs from logging_server_2 and receives replicated state from DC1

elements.name: SIEM DC2
elements.description: Local SIEM in DC2. Pulls logs from logging_server_2, receives replicated detection state from siem_1, and takes over correlation duties on failover
